landing.lead: IrereroAI ifasha uturere gutegura aho amarerero akenewe, ifasha amarerero gutanga raporo mu minota itatu, kandi ifasha ababyeyi kubona umwanya hafi. AI itanga inama. Abantu bafata ibyemezo.

cycle.caption: Uruziga rumwe: ibyo amarerero atangaza n'ibyo ababyeyi basaba binoza igenamigambi rikurikira.

plan.text: Shyira ku rutonde aho kubaka, kuzamura cyangwa gushyigikira amarerero mu ngengo y'imari.

promise.suggests: Buri gisubizo ni inama, si icyemezo.
promise.reasons: Buri nama yerekana impamvu zayo, intera n'amakuru yakoreshejwe.
promise.reject: Abategura bemeza, bahindura cyangwa banga; kwanga bisaba impamvu, kandi iyo mpamvu ihindura igenamigambi rikurikira.
promise.audit: Buri cyemezo cyandikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura kidashobora guhindurwa.
promise.nothingAutomatic: Nta kintu gikorwa mu buryo bwikora.

honesty.simulated: Iri ni igerageza. Amarerero, raporo za buri cyumweru, imibare y'abana n'igereranya ni iby'igerageza by'i Gicumbi kandi byanditsweho "amakuru y'igerageza" aho bigaragara hose.
honesty.real: Imbibi z'uturere n'imirenge ni amakuru nyayo rusange (NISR binyuze kuri geoBoundaries). Umubare w'igwingira i Gicumbi ni uwatangajwe na RDHS 2025; imibare y'imirenge iwukikije ni iy'igerageza.
honesty.phase2: Icyiciro cya 2 kizashyira ibarura rusange, EICV7, DHS, ubushakashatsi ku murimo, imibare y'uburezi n'urutonde rwa NCDA muri izi nzego zimwe.
honesty.privacy: Nta mazina, amafoto cyangwa nimero by'abana bikusanywa. Aho ababyeyi bari hazengurutswa kuri kare ya metero 500.

parents.title: Ababyeyi
parents.text: Shaka irerero ryagenzuwe riri hafi, n'amafaranga, amasaha n'imyanya iboneka.

caregivers.title: Abarezi

officers.title: Abakozi b'imirenge

find.title: Shaka irerero
find.lead: Amarerero yagenzuwe ari hafi y'aho uhisemo. Aho uri neza ntihabikwa.
find.mapHint: Cyangwa kanda ku ikarita uhitemo ahantu.
find.pickFirst: Hitamo umurenge cyangwa ukande ku ikarita urebe amarerero ari hafi.
find.signInToSave: Injira kugira ngo ubike ubu bushakashatsi
find.noneText: Nta rerero ryagenzuwe riri muri iyi ntera rihuje n'ibyo washakaga.
find.counted: Ubu bushakashatsi bwabaruwe nk'icyifuzo cy'irerero muri aka gace.
find.requested: Murakoze. Icyifuzo cyanyu cyabaruwe ku gace ka {sector}.
find.privacy: Habikwa kare ya metero 500 ikikije aho hantu gusa, ntihabikwa aho nyirizina cyangwa nimero ya telefone yawe.
find.freePlacesNote: Imyanya iboneka ituruka kuri raporo y'icyumweru iheruka y'irerero. Imibare iri munsi ya 5 ntigaragazwa.

methodology.title: Uko bikora
methodology.lead: Uko amakuru akoreshwa kuva ku masoko kugeza ku cyemezo umuntu afata, n'ibiri ukuri uyu munsi n'ibiri igerageza.

sources.title: Amasoko
sources.what: Imibare ya Leta, amakarita rusange n'urutonde rw'abafatanyabikorwa.
sources.today: Imbibi nyazo; ibindi byose ni igerageza ry'i Gicumbi.
sources.phase2: Ibarura rusange 2022, EICV7, DHS 2025, LFS 2025, igitabo cy'imibare y'uburezi, urutonde rwa NCDA, WorldPop, OpenStreetMap.

alignment.title: Guhuza
alignment.what: Buri soko rihuzwa n'imirenge, n'umwaka waryo, inkomoko n'igenzura.
alignment.today: Porogaramu y'igerageza yandika imbonerahamwe zimwe ifite inkomoko = igerageza.
alignment.phase2: Uburyo bumwe kuri buri soko, n'igenzura rigomba gutsinda mbere yo kwinjiza amakuru.

models.title: Imiterere y'imibare
models.what: Ibikenewe kuri buri murenge n'intera, ahagerwa n'amaguru, n'iburira hakiri kare.
models.today: Uburyo bworoshye busobanurwa: igereranya ryabitswe, intera y'umurongo ugororotse, amategeko agereranya buri rerero n'amateka yaryo.
models.phase2: Igereranya ry'uduce duto rihuzwa n'imibare ya Leta, igihe cyo kugenda n'amaguru, no kubona ibidasanzwe.

suggestions.title: Inama
suggestions.what: Urutonde rugufi mu ngengo y'imari, n'impamvu, intera n'amasoko.
suggestions.today: Guhitamo intambwe ku yindi hakurikijwe uburemere mwahisemo; bigereranywa n'igipimo cy'abaturage benshi mbere.
suggestions.phase2: Uburyo nyabwo bwo gushaka igisubizo cyiza inyuma ya paji imwe.

decision.title: Icyemezo cy'umuntu
decision.what: Emeza, hindura cyangwa wange. Kwanga bisaba impamvu.
decision.today: Birakora byuzuye, n'igitabo cy'igenzura kidashobora guhindurwa.
decision.phase2: Nta gihinduka: abantu ni bo bafata ibyemezo buri gihe.

feedback.title: Kwiga
feedback.what: Raporo za buri cyumweru, ibyifuzo by'ababyeyi n'impamvu zo kwanga bihindura inama zikurikira.
feedback.today: Ibyanzwe biba imbogamizi; ibyifuzo by'ababyeyi bizamura agaciro k'ahantu; raporo zitera iburira.
feedback.phase2: Imiterere y'imibare yongera kwigishwa hakurikijwe ibyemezo na raporo.

plan.name: Izina ry'igenamigambi
plan.runNote: Inama zirabikwa. Ahanzwe hakomeza gukurwa mu igenamigambi rikurikira.
